related.title: 釩液流電池堆系統工程
related.titleEn: Vanadium Flow Battery Stack Systems Engineering
related.transfer: 可遷移「模組數與系統能量」與「定期剝鋅與可用率」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；釩液流電池堆系統工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Module count and system energy" and "Periodic stripping and availability" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Vanadium Flow Battery Stack Systems Engineering must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦把鋅鍍上去再溶下來的電池：鋅的沉積量、泵的待機損失、剝鋅維護與效率；釩液流電池堆系統工程則以能量存在液體裡的電池：電解液體積、釩用量、電堆面積、泵功、時長成本與旁路電流為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A battery that plates zinc and strips it again: zinc deposited, standby pump loss, stripping maintenance and efficiency; Vanadium Flow Battery Stack Systems Engineering centres on A battery whose energy is in liquid: electrolyte volume, vanadium needed, stack area, pumping, cost against duration and shunt current, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「功率、能量與時長」與「功率、能量與時長」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「循環壽命與能量吞吐」的模型移到釩液流電池堆系統工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「電解液泵的功率」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Power, energy and duration" and "Power, energy and duration".
Move the model of "Cycle life and energy throughput" to Vanadium Flow Battery Stack Systems Engineering, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Power of the electrolyte pumps", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「模組數與系統能量」與「定期剝鋅與可用率」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；釩液流電池堆系統工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Module count and system energy" and "Periodic stripping and availability" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Vanadium Flow Battery Stack Systems Engineering must be respecified.

related.title: 超級電容模組均衡設計
related.transfer: 可遷移「模組數與系統能量」與「定期剝鋅與可用率」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；超級電容模組均衡設計的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Module count and system energy" and "Periodic stripping and availability" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Supercapacitor Module Balancing Design must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦把鋅鍍上去再溶下來的電池：鋅的沉積量、泵的待機損失、剝鋅維護與效率；超級電容模組均衡設計則以幾秒鐘的儲能：電容儲能、可用電壓範圍、串聯不均、被動均衡、最大功率與時間常數為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A battery that plates zinc and strips it again: zinc deposited, standby pump loss, stripping maintenance and efficiency; Supercapacitor Module Balancing Design centres on storage for seconds: capacitor energy, usable voltage range, series imbalance, passive balancing, peak power and time constant, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「功率、能量與時長」與「儲存的能量」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「循環壽命與能量吞吐」的模型移到超級電容模組均衡設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「最大輸出功率」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Power, energy and duration" and "Energy stored".
Move the model of "Cycle life and energy throughput" to Supercapacitor Module Balancing Design, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Peak output power", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「模組數與系統能量」與「定期剝鋅與可用率」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；超級電容模組均衡設計的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Module count and system energy" and "Periodic stripping and availability" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Supercapacitor Module Balancing Design must be respecified.

history.title: 鋅溴液流電池循環系統
history.text: 1970 年鋅溴液流電池開始發展；2018 年10 kWh 模組開始量產；2021 年加州的 2 MWh 系統安裝完成。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1970: Development of zinc-bromine flow batteries began. 2018: Production of 10 kWh modules began. 2021: The 2 MWh system in California was installed. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
